endless-mode-hint: 엔드리스 모드는 일반 한계를 넘어 난이도를 높입니다
gyro-active: Motion sensor live. Press C or tap recenter to face forward again.
gyro-denied: Motion access was declined, so the camera stays locked forward. You can allow it in your browser settings.
gyro-off: Head look is off — the camera stays locked forward.
gyro-unavailable: No motion sensor here — the camera stays locked forward.
keyboard-controls: W/↑ 가속 · A/D 또는 ←/→ 조향 · S/↓ 브레이크 · Shift 부스트 · C 시야 중앙 정렬 · Esc 일시정지
menu-tagline: 1인칭 고속도로 서바이벌 레이서. 운전대를 잡고, 운전 중 조종석 주변을 둘러보며 리더보드를 추격하세요.
mode-fixed-hint: Camera locked straight ahead. No motion needed.
mode-gyro-hint: One screen. Move your device to look around as you drive.
mode-vr-hint: Split screen for a headset or phone viewer. Turn your head to steer; tap to boost.
paused-hint: Tap the screen or press Esc to resume
touch-controls-hint: 게임 플레이 중 터치 컨트롤이 나타납니다
unlock-hint: 레벨에서 1,500m를 주행하여 완료하고 다음 레벨을 잠금 해제하세요
webgl-required-body: Neon Driftway needs WebGL, and this browser could not start it. Try a different browser, or enable hardware acceleration in your settings.
